name: Wall chest pass
why: Keepers push the ball when passing or punching. Practise a two-handed push.

setup.space: Stand 2 m from a solid wall. Clear the rebound path. Move breakables away.
setup.equipment: A football, a solid wall and goalkeeper gloves. No medicine ball.
setup.parent: Stand side-on, away from the ball and rebound path.

steps: Put on goalkeeper gloves. Stand about 2 m from the wall.
Hold the football at your chest with both hands.
Push the ball to the wall at chest height. Straighten both arms together.
Catch the rebound. Bring the ball back to your chest.

mistakes.mistake: The ball starts away from the chest
mistakes.fix: Bring the ball to your chest before each push.

mistakes.mistake: One arm finishes before the other
The ball hits too high or low
mistakes.fix: Aim for chest height on the wall.

parent_check: Ball leaves from the chest with both hands
Ball hits the wall at about chest height
stop_if: Pain in a wrist or finger
Pain in the shoulder or elbow
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath

easier.use_when: The rebound or pass is hard to control.

harder.variant: Practise the next approved punch shape.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean at 2 x 15, two sessions in a row. Then the owner approves.
